arxiv-2203-11589.title: Adaptive Patch Exiting for Scalable Single Image Super-Resolution
arxiv-2203-11589.creator: Shizun Wang, Jiaming Liu, Kaixin Chen, Xiaoqi Li, Ming Lu, Yandong Guo
arxiv-2203-11589.description: Abstract Since the future of computing is heterogeneous, scalability is a crucial problem for single image super-resolution. Recent works try to train one network, which can be deployed on platforms with different capacities. However, they rely on the pixel-wise sparse convolution, which is not hardware-friendly and achieves limited practical speedup.

arxiv-2311-08231.title: High Intensity Kaon Experiments (HIKE) at the CERN SPS
arxiv-2311-08231.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . A timely and long-term programme of kaon decay measurements at an unprecedented level of precision is presented, leveraging the capabilities of the CERN Super Proton Synchrotron (SPS). The proposed HIKE programme is firmly anchored on the experience built up studying kaon decays at the SPS over the past four decades, and includes rare processes, CP violation, dark sectors, symmetry tests and other tests of the Standard Model.

arxiv-2404-09413.title: On the Optimal Regret of Locally Private Linear Contextual Bandit
arxiv-2404-09413.creator: Jiachun Li, David Simchi-Levi, Yining Wang
arxiv-2404-09413.description: Abstract Contextual bandit with linear reward functions is among one of the most extensively studied models in bandit and online learning research. Recently, there has been increasing interest in designing locally private linear contextual bandit algorithms, where sensitive information contained in contexts and rewards is protected against leakage to the general public.

arxiv-2504-08855.title: Exponential Shift: Humans Adapt to AI Economies
arxiv-2504-08855.creator: Kevin J McNamara, Rhea Pritham Marpu
arxiv-2504-08855.description: Abstract This paper explores how artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics are transforming the global labor market. Human workers, limited to a 33% duty cycle due to rest and holidays, cost $14 to $55 per hour. In contrast, digital labor operates nearly 24/7 at just $0.10 to $0.50 per hour.

arxiv-2508-09412.title: A pseudo-inverse of a line graph
arxiv-2508-09412.creator: Sevvandi Kandanaarachchi, Philip Kilby, Cheng Soon Ong
arxiv-2508-09412.description: Abstract Line graphs are an alternative representation of graphs where each vertex of the original (root) graph becomes an edge. However not all graphs have a corresponding root graph, hence the transformation from graphs to line graphs is not invertible.

arxiv-2511-14243.title: Newborn jet in the symbiotic system R Aquarii
arxiv-2511-14243.creator: T. Liimets, D. P. K. Banerjee, M. Santander-García, J. Alcolea, S. B. Howell, U. Munari, B. Deshev, C. E. Woodward, A. Evans, E. Furlan, T. Geballe, R. D. Gehrz, V. Joshi, N. Scott, S. Starrfield
arxiv-2511-14243.description: Abstract Context. R Aquarii (R Aqr) is a well-known symbiotic binary that has attracted renewed interest during its recent periastron passage, an event that occurs only once every ∼ \sim 40 years. This passage marks the first to be observed with modern, state-of-the-art instruments. Aims.

pmc-11313731.title: Body Mass Index and the Risk of Adult-Onset Asthma: A Prospective Observational Study among 59,668 Middle-Aged Men and Women in Finland
pmc-11313731.creator: Ville A. Vartiainen, Pekka Jousilahti, Jaakko Tuomilehto, Tiina Laatikainen, Erkki Vartiainen
pmc-11313731.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: Obesity, in addition to many other negative health consequences, affects pulmonary function and is a potential risk factor for asthma. Methods: We analyzed the association of body mass index (BMI) with incident asthma among 60,639 Finnish men and women aged 25 to 74 years who participated in a population-based chronic disease risk factor survey in 1972, 1977, 1982, 1987, 1992, 1997, 2002, 2007, or 2012.

pmc-11453903.title: 8009 The Unravelling of a Perfect Storm: A Case of COVID-19 Induced Thyroid Storm Presenting as Heart Failure and Atrial Fibrillation
pmc-11453903.creator: Mohammad Amaan Parvez, Anusha Kavarthapu, Sagar Nagpal, Lana Makahleh, Krishna Pulivarthi
pmc-11453903.description: Disclosure: M. Parvez: None. A. Kavarthapu: None. S. nagpal: None. L. Makahleh: None. K. Pulivarthi: None. Introduction: Thyroid storm is an uncommon but life-threatening complication of hyperthyroidism characterized by a sudden and exaggerated release of thyroid hormones into the circulation. This leads to a cascade of systemic manifestations, including cardiovascular instability.

pmc-11509781.title: Minimally Invasive Plate Osteosynthesis with Mini-Open Technique and Supraclavicular Nerve Preservation Reduces Postoperative Numbness in Acute Displaced Midshaft Clavicle Fracture
pmc-11509781.creator: Li-Tzu Liu, Jian-Chih Chen, Tsung-Cheng Yang, Hsiang-Jui Tseng, Shen-Ho Yen, Cheng-Chang Lu, Chung-Hwan Chen, Wan-Rong Chung, Ying-Chun Wang, Erich Rutz, Sung-Sahn Lee, Dong Jin Ryu
pmc-11509781.description: Background: Minimally invasive plate osteosynthesis (MIPO) for clavicular shaft fracture yields favorable functional outcomes and results in less surgery-related soft tissue injury than other techniques. Anterior chest and shoulder skin numbness, a common complication after open reduction and plate fixation, is related to injury to the supraclavicular nerves.

pmc-13052869.title: Multiproxy stable isotope analysis provides insights into diet, animal management, and residential mobility in Old Bara, a metropolitan suburb of the Oyo Empire, West Africa
pmc-13052869.creator: Moses Oluwaseyi Akogun, Paul Szpak, Vicky M Oelze, Kendra Leishman, Jay Hilsden, Camilla Speller, Lisa Janz, Jonathan O Aleru, Akinwumi Ogundiran, Enrico Greco, Enrico Greco, Enrico Greco, Enrico Greco
pmc-13052869.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Old Bara was a royal suburb in the metropolis of the Oyo Empire, one of the most important political entities in Africa, ca. Much of what is known about this town is limited to a few written and oral accounts about its functions as a royal cemetery where the priests and priestesses of the deified kings and other dependents also resided. These limited sources suggest that as a secluded site, Old Bara depended on the palace for its provisions.

pmc-13099613.title: Constrained evolutionary funnels shape viral immune escape
pmc-13099613.creator: Marian Huot, Dianzhuo Wang, Eugene Shakhnovich, Rémi Monasson, Simona Cocco
pmc-13099613.description: SignificanceViruses evolve to evade our immune defenses, but with constraints. Like navigating a high-dimensional minefield, each step toward immune escape comes at the potential cost of structural stability and functionality. We show that despite the vast mutational space, immune escape is funneled into a small set of predictable pathways.

pmc-13114091.title: Astragaloside IV from Astragalus membranaceus Fisch. ex Bunge Mitigates DSS-Induced Colitis via Anti-Inflammatory and Antioxidant Modulation of the Gut–Liver–Brain Axis
pmc-13114091.creator: Woo-Gyun Choi, Byung Joo Kim
pmc-13114091.description: Background: Astragalus membranaceus Fisch. ex Bunge has long been used in East Asian medicine for gastrointestinal disorders and immune modulation. Astragaloside IV (AS-IV), a major bioactive saponin from its roots, exhibits potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, yet its protective effects against inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)-associated multi-organ damage via the gut–liver–brain axis remain unclear.

pmc-13135524.title: Pupillometry for pain assessment in noncommunicating children in the pediatric intensive care unit: a prospective accuracy study
pmc-13135524.creator: A Portefaix, M Rabilloud, F Baudin, E Dantony, T Ginhoux, B Kassaï-Koupaï, E Javouhey, F Bordet
pmc-13135524.description: Pain assessment in noncommunicating children in pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) remains a significant clinical challenge, particularly in deeply sedated patients. Pupillometry, a noninvasive objective technique, showed promise in anesthesia settings, but its relevance in PICU is unclear. We assessed feasibility and diagnostic performance of video pupillometry for pain assessment in noncommunicating intubated children in PICU.

pmc-13406954.title: A Hybrid Multi-Strategy Chinese Pangolin Optimization Algorithm and Its Applications
pmc-13406954.creator: Chaochuan Jia, Yaqi Yang, Yujie Cheng, Maosheng Fu, Bao Zhou, Jiahui Liu, Yu Liu

pmc-13546801.title: Treatment‐Free Remission in Chronic Myeloid Leukemia: Toward Precision and Personalized Approaches to Functional Cure
pmc-13546801.creator: Hiroshi Ureshino, Shinya Kimura
pmc-13546801.description: Treatment‐free remission (TFR), defined as the maintenance of molecular remission without resumption of therapy after tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) discontinuation, represents the clinical manifestation of functional cure in chronic‐phase chronic myeloid leukemia (CML‐CP), in which durable disease control is maintained without ongoing therapy despite the potential persistence of residual leukemic stem cells (LSCs).

pmc-13591368.title: Autophagy Inhibition Enhances the Antitumor Efficacy of MET Targeting in MET-High Pancreatic Cancer
pmc-13591368.creator: Zhiyi Min, Chunbin Wang, Tongjin Yin, Wanyan Jiao, Dandan Zhou, Xuyao Zhang, Junli Cui, Zhe Ding
pmc-13591368.description: Objectives: MET inhibitors have demonstrated clinical efficacy in several MET-driven malignancies; however, their therapeutic potential in pancreatic cancer remains insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to evaluate the antitumor activity of the selective MET inhibitor savolitinib in MET-high pancreatic cancer and to investigate the role of autophagy in the cellular response to MET inhibition.
